description.en: The start time for filtering memories by creation time. Must be in UTC and ISO 8601 format.
The end time for filtering memories by creation time. Must be in UTC and ISO 8601 format.
The agent ID associated with the memory.
The user ID associated with the memory.
The maximum number of results to return.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb search-memories --application-id pa-00000000000000 --query who_are_you --memory-user-id user1 --memory-agent-id agent1 --topk 3 --create-time-begin yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ --create-time-end yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb SearchMemories --region cn-hangzhou --TopK 3 --Query who_are_you --MemoryUserId user1 --MemoryAgentId agent1 --CreateTimeEnd 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ' --ApplicationId 'pa-00000000000000' --CreateTimeBegin 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ'
